title: μέν … δέ balance
subtitle: Read paired units without forcing “on the one hand.”
overview: μέν often prepares a unit that δέ balances, develops, or contrasts. English may translate both, one, or neither depending on the paragraph.
Mark the paired elements first. Then ask whether the writer contrasts people, actions, claims, or stages of an argument.

items.grc: ὁ μὲν σπείρει, ὁ δὲ θερίζει.
τὸ μὲν πνεῦμα πρόθυμον, ἡ δὲ σὰρξ ἀσθενής.
items.en: The spirit is willing, but the flesh is weak.
